mapper.select: SELECT c.company_id, c.company_code, a.user_account_id, e.employee_no, a.email FROM company c JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = c.company_id JOIN user_account a ON a.company_id = e.company_id AND a.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE c.company_code = #{companyCode} AND e.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND a.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND a.role_code != 'ROLE_OPS'

SELECT SQ_EMAIL_VERIFICATION.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO email_verification (email_verification_id, company_id, user_account_id, purpose_code, email, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{emailVerificationId}, #{companyId}, #{userAccountId}, , #{email}, #{tokenHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: MERGE INTO email_rate_limit t USING (SELECT #{companyId} AS company_id, #{email} AS email, AS purpose_code, #{today} AS quota_date FROM dual) s ON (t.company_id = s.company_id AND t.email = s.email AND t.purpose_code = s.purpose_code AND t.quota_date = s.quota_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.sent_count = t.sent_count + 1, t.last_sent_at = #{now}, t.updated_at = #{now} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (company_id, email, purpose_code, quota_date, sent_count, last_sent_at) VALUES (s.company_id, s.email, s.purpose_code, s.quota_date, 1, #{now})

mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = #{now}, failed_login_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND user_account_id = #{userAccountId} AND status_code = 'ACTIVE'
